name: Harbor: Share to the world
subtitle: You hold the keys
promotionalText: You hold the keys, and your posts go to every server you choose. An open-source social network built on the Polycentric Protocol.
description:
Share to the world, not platforms.

Harbor is an open-source, distributed social network. You hold the keys, and your posts go to every server you choose. No company owns the network, and no single server owns you.

SOVEREIGN IDENTITY
Your identity is made of cryptographic keypairs that you create for free and keep yourself. It is not an account that a company can suspend. Nobody else can post as you, and nobody can take your name, your history, or your followers. Add a second device by scanning a QR code, and keep a backup so you can recover without asking anyone’s permission.

NO SILOS
You post to the world, not to a server. Every post goes to all the servers you use. If one shuts down or bans you, your audience can still reach you through the rest. Pick your servers in Settings and change them whenever you like.

MODERATION YOU CHOOSE
No single company decides what you see. Each server sets its own policy, and you pick the servers whose moderation you trust. Content labels let you hide, warn, or show posts in each category, and you can report any post or block any user.

RECOMMENDATIONS THAT ANSWER TO YOU
Your feed is ranked for you, not for advertisers. The For You feed is computed by the servers you use, and each suggestion is attributed to the server that made it, so no single server controls what you see. Switch to Following for the people you follow, newest first or ranked.

EVERYTHING YOU EXPECT FROM A SOCIAL APP
• Posts up to 2000 characters with up to four photos and link previews
• Replies, quotes, reposts, and emoji reactions
• Follow people across any server
• Search for posts and people across your servers
• Push notifications for follows, replies, reactions, and verifications
• Readable usernames backed by a domain you control, like you@yourdomain.com
• Verifications: prove you own your GitHub, YouTube, X, Discord, Twitch, or website, and let people you trust vouch for claims about you
• Light and dark themes

BUILT IN THE OPEN
Harbor is the flagship app for the Polycentric Protocol. The protocol, the app, and the server are open source, and anyone can run a server or build a client that interoperates with the rest of the network. Browse Explore and Search without creating an identity.

Docs and source: https://join.harbor.social
whatsNew: Harbor is now on the App Store. Share to the world, not platforms. You hold the keys, and your posts go to every server you choose.
reviewNotes:
There is no sign-in. Explore and Search work without an identity. To post, follow or react, tap "Create identity" on the welcome screen and enter a display name. No email, phone or password is needed.

Users can report any post from its "..." menu and block any user from their profile. Content policy: https://join.harbor.social/docs/content-policy-app-stores

The app does not use non-exempt encryption.
